question_text: Across all crowd-mode cameras (ExpoFloor_MainAisle, DemoBooth_NVIDIA, DemoBooth_Intel, KeynoteHall_Stage, FoodCourt_North) on 2025-12-08 (UTC), which location showed the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast — meaning the largest ratio of its peak head_count to its overnight quiet-hour average head_count? Identify the camera_location and explain the ratio order of magnitude.
answer_text: KeynoteHall_Stage. Peak head_count = 500 vs overnight_avg_hc = 7.085, giving a ratio = 70.57163020465772 — roughly a 70× contrast (order of magnitude: >=10×, i.e., between one and two orders of magnitude).

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour)
WHERE ch.camera_location IN ['ExpoFloor_MainAisle','DemoBooth_NVIDIA','DemoBooth_Intel','KeynoteHall_Stage','FoodCourt_North']
  AND ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
WITH ch.camera_location AS camera_location,
     max(ch.peak_hc) AS peak_hc,
     avg(CASE WHEN ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T06:00:00Z' THEN ch.avg_hc ELSE NULL END) AS overnight_avg_hc
WITH camera_location, peak_hc, overnight_avg_hc,
     CASE WHEN overnight_avg_hc IS NULL OR overnight_avg_hc = 0 THEN NULL ELSE toFloat(peak_hc)/overnight_avg_hc END AS ratio
WHERE ratio IS NOT NULL
RETURN camera_location, peak_hc, overnight_avg_hc, ratio,
  CASE WHEN ratio < 1 THEN '<1x'
       WHEN ratio < 2 THEN '≈1x'
       WHEN ratio < 10 THEN '>=2x'
       WHEN ratio < 100 THEN '>=10x'
       WHEN ratio < 1000 THEN '>=100x'
       ELSE '>=1000x' END AS ratio_order_of_magnitude
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 1
